mapping: A multi-tine feeler comb descends over a bank of eight bistable rocker flags: inserting a token stamps its hashed flags flat, while probing a token checks whether any flag remains upright to stop the comb at half stroke.
parts: The base consists of a ground plate on four stepped brass feet with four corner set-screws, an inset perimeter oil groove, and a soft base shadow. The structure comprises twin cast pillow blocks, a ground central pivot axle with inter-cell spacer rings, a rear travel-stop beam, a front indicator bezel bar, two polished vertical guide pillars with collar stops, and an arched top bridge bar capped with acorn nuts. The mechanism features a gantry carriage sliding on twin bronze bushings, an underside comb mount with eight tine collars, three solid downward feeler tines, a bridge-mounted operating rocker lever with a knurled spherical brass grip, and an articulated pushrod link. The subject consists of eight counterweighted rocker-flag toggles with anvil strike heads and latch lips, along with eight engraved front-rail register numeral glyphs.
